notes: Polymarket and Kalshi prices split after about 21:00 UTC because their contracts treat a seat tie differently. Polymarket gives a tie to the alphabetically first party (D66), so a D66 share paid $1. Kalshi splits a tie, paying $0.50 to each tied party. As a 26-26 tie became likely, Polymarket's D66 price rose toward $1 and Kalshi's D66 and PVV prices moved toward $0.50. Both were consistent with their own rules; the gap is not a mispricing.

RETROSPECTIVE replay, not pre-registered. No count history: market vs outcome only. Nothing official or openly licensed recorded the Dutch count by gemeente during the night, so the page shows Polymarket prices against the official final result and a projection made before any votes; there is no minute-by-minute count model, accuracy or profit result.

Count sources checked for 2025-10-29 20:00 to 2025-10-30 12:00 UTC: the Kiesraad results site verkiezingsuitslagen.nl has no archived election page before 2025-11-14; NOS's results app (app.nos.nl/nieuws/tk2025) was captured about 11 times but its pages load the numbers by script and the archived copies say 'Wachten op uitslagen' (waiting for results); municipal sites publish their own results only.

Prices: Polymarket 1-minute YES price, 2025-10-29T18:00:00Z to 2025-10-30T12:00:00Z (19:00 to 13:00 CET); a row is written only when the price moves (plus the last minute); Kalshi's 1-minute prices for the 5 'most seats' markets it quoted (D66, PVV, GL/PvdA, VVD, CDA). Settled = the eventual outcome's price stays >= 0.9 from then to the end of the window (a 0.95 version is in stats.settle). Kalshi settled D66 and PVV at $0.50 each (a tie split, scalar); Polymarket gave the tie to D66; settle.kalshi applies the same 0.9 rule to the Polymarket outcome.

Races: each Polymarket question is its own two-way race, A = YES. Most seats (15 parties) and second most seats (6) follow the market rule: most seats, a tie going to the alphabetically first abbreviation; six parties' seat-band markets are scored too.

Projection (before any votes): 'without polls' = the 2023 result (shares of the 16 lists with a seat) with a share error sd = 0.174 x sqrt(b(1-b)); 'with polls' (the model line) = the average of each pollster's last poll ending 1-7 days before the vote (seats/150), error sd = 0.048 x sqrt(b(1-b)). Both go through the Tweede Kamer seat allocation (D'Hondt among lists with a full quota; reproduces the official 2017-2025 seats) in 20,000 simulated elections. Settings were chosen on 2017, 2021 and 2023 only (configs/nl2025_v1.toml); they are not frozen in the repository before scoring.
Result: D66 26 seats, PVV 26, VVD 22, GL/PvdA 20, CDA 18, JA21 9. D66 and PVV tied on 26 seats; the 'most seats' markets resolved to D66 by the alphabetical tie-break (D66 also had the most votes).

Map: one final frame (its time is the end of the price window; the Kiesraad publishes the official result later). Colour = D66 share of D66 + PVV votes by gemeente; prior = the same in 2023; the frame's 'proj' = the 2023 gemeente result scaled by the polling swing (mean absolute error 4.0 pts against 27.1 for the 2023 result unchanged); 'swing' = change in the share x1000. 342 gemeenten; Bonaire, Sint Eustatius, Saba and the voters abroad are in the national totals but not on the map.
Of the 342 gemeenten on the map, PVV had the most votes in 158 and D66 in 80; D66 won the national vote through the cities.
